action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that feh incorrectly handled certain IPC messages from a
client pretending to be the Enlightenment window manager, leading to an
integer overflow. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause feh to
crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary
code.
isummary:
feh could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it received
specially crafted input.
title: feh vulnerability
